## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important

It's no longer possible to create `input_select` with duplicated options. Duplicated options will be removed from the list of options and a warning will be logged. The service `input_select.set_options` will fail if options are duplicated.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Remove duplicated options from `input_select` because it broke the services `select_next` and `select_previous`, and made the service `select_option` ambiguous.

With this change:
- An input_select created or updated from the UI with duplicated options will have the duplicates dropped
- An input select loaded from YAML will have the duplicates dropped
- An input select updated with the service `input_select.set_options` will fail if options are duplicated

As a possible follow-up, we could make InputSelect accept key/value pairs instead of a list
- The state of the InputSelect would be the value, with the key available as an attribute (or the other way around)
- Not sure how this can be made backwards compatible, maybe we could store an `options_dict` along side the `options` to allow the user to downgrade

issue_context.title: Input select - Select next getting stuck with duplicate items
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Originally posted on forum: [Input select - Select next getting stuck while cycling through options ](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/input-select-select-next-getting-stuck-while-cycling-through-options/379657)

After asking on the Discord server, moderator RobC pointed out that this could be an issue:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/90249913/149621034-d637a9cf-0828-4b4a-95c1-1e02bf9f99cb.png)

It appears that if an `input_select` has items that are not unique in the list, it would revert to the first occurrence of that item and never update beyond it.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.9

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Helper - Input Select

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/input_select/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
input_select:
  red_color:
    options:
      - 255
      - 255
      - 255
      - 239
      - 119
      - 70
      - 0
      - 0
      - 0
      - 255
  green_color:
    options:
      - 239
      - 96
      - 71
      - 70
      - 70
      - 144
      - 255
      - 255
      - 255
      - 174
  blue_color:
    options:
      - 72
      - 71
      - 129
      - 255
      - 255
      - 255
      - 255
      - 106
      - 0
      - 0
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Nothing in the logs
```


### Additional information

Example Automation:

```
- id: '1642148439200'
  alias: Lights Control (Automation)
  description: ''
  trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: sensor.button_click
    to: double
    id: double
  condition: []
  action:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.lamp
    data:
      rgb_color:
      - '{{ states(''input_select.red_color'') }}'
      - '{{ states(''input_select.green_color'') }}'
      - '{{ states(''input_select.blue_color'') }}'
  - service: input_select.select_next
    target:
      entity_id:
      - input_select.red_color
      - input_select.green_color
      - input_select.blue_color
  mode: single
```
comments:
Hey there @home-assistant/core, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`input_select`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L438) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Until the bug is fixed, you can mitigate the problem by consolidating RGB into a single `input_select` and modifying the automation like this:

```yaml
input_select:
  light_color:
    options:
      - 255,239,72
      - 255,96,71
      - 255,71,129
      - 239,70,255
      - 119,70,255
      - 70,144,255
      - 0,255,255
      - 0,255,106
      - 0,255,0
      - 255,174,0
```

```yaml
- id: '1642148439200'
  alias: Lights Control (Automation)
  description: ''
  trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: sensor.button_click
    to: double
    id: double
  condition: []
  action:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.lamp
    data:
      rgb_color: "{{ states('input_select.light_color').split(',') }}"
  - service: input_select.select_next
    target:
      entity_id: input_select.light_color
  mode: single
```
That should work for now, provided each option's value is unique (otherwise it will encounter the bug again).

@tdejneka Thank you for the workaround :)

I actually did something similar, but with an `input_number` instead. I think your solution is less code, so I will probably implement it. Thank you!

The problem is that `input_select` does not keep track of the index selected, it instead keeps track of the selected value.
We should either validate the options and not allow duplicated options, or keep track of which index is selected.

A problem with the latter is that it makes restoring the state ambiguous.

It's not really feasible to support duplicated options, selecting an option would still be ambiguous because that's done by selecting a value, not an index. The linked PR hence deprecates creating or updating input_select with duplicated options.
